description: This Java source file defines the DataResourceWorker class, which handles various operations related to content data resources including uploading, rendering, streaming, MIME type detection, and content management within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for processing different data resource types such as text, files, URLs, images, and media objects, and supports templating and cache management.

classes.name: DataResourceWorker
classes.description: Implements content data resource management including upload, rendering, streaming, and MIME type detection within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getDataCategoryMap
methods.description: Recursively traverses DataCategory hierarchy and populates categoryNode with child categories.

methods.name: getDataCategoryAncestry
methods.description: Builds list of DataCategory ancestors up to root.

methods.name: buildList
methods.description: Creates an indented list of DataCategory IDs and names for dropdowns.

methods.name: uploadAndStoreImage
methods.description: Handles uploading image data from form and stores it in ImageDataResource.

methods.name: getMimeTypeFromImageFileName
methods.description: Returns MIME type based on image filename extension.

methods.name: callDataResourcePermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks permission for content access.

methods.name: callDataResourcePermissionCheckResult
methods.description: Performs detailed permission check and returns result map.

methods.name: acquireImage
methods.description: Retrieves image data as byte array from DataResource.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type for a DataResource, with optional default.

methods.name: getMimeTypeWithByteBuffer
methods.description: Detects MIME type from ByteBuffer content using Tika.

methods.name: buildRequestPrefix
methods.description: Builds URL prefix based on site and protocol.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Gets a java.io.File object for a given data resource type and info.

methods.name: getDataResourceMimeType
methods.description: Gets MIME type associated with a DataResource.

methods.name: getDataResourceContentUploadPath
methods.description: Determines storage path for uploaded content, supporting directory management.

methods.name: getDataResourceStream
methods.description: Streams binary data from DataResource (file, URL, object) for output.

methods.name: getContentAsByteBuffer
methods.description: Loads DataResource content into ByteBuffer.

methods.name: renderDataResourceAsText
methods.description: Renders DataResource content as text, possibly applying templates.

methods.name: writeDataResourceText
methods.description: Outputs DataResource content (with templating) to Appendable.

methods.name: writeText
methods.description: Renders DataResource text content with optional MIME type templates.

methods.name: renderMimeTypeTemplate
methods.description: Renders mime type template using FreeMarker.

methods.name: renderFile
methods.description: Loads and outputs content from local or remote files, assuming text content.
